text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

translations.asad: SAY: "I seek refuge with the Sustainer of the rising dawn,
translations.sahih: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

translations.asad: "from the evil of aught that He has created,
translations.sahih: From the evil of that which He created

translations.asad: "and from the evil of the black darkness whenever it descends,
translations.sahih: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

translations.asad: "and from the evil of all human beings bent on occult endeavours,
translations.sahih: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

translations.asad: "and from the evil of the envious when he envies."
translations.sahih: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
